description: An upright accordion seen from the front. A narrow keyboard panel with five short key bars sits at the left, beside a zigzag pleated bellows and a plain rounded end panel at the right.
A pear-shaped lute body lies on a diagonal toward the lower left, with a small bridge slot on its face. A long straight neck rises to the upper right, crossed by three tuning-peg bars near its head.
A landscape rounded-rectangle album case with a vertical spine line near its left edge. A pair of beamed eighth notes fills the cover area to the right of the spine.

A large circular disc with a ringed centre hub and a small spindle hole. Two pairs of straight radial lines, one at the upper left and one at the lower right, mark reflection bands across the surface.
An upright double bass with a waisted body, a central string line, and a peg head with crossbars stands at the left. A music stand with a tilted rectangular desk on a tripod base stands at the right.

A double bass lies on a diagonal toward the lower left, its scrolled waisted body marked by two curved f-holes. A long straight neck passes through the body and ends in a crossed peg head at the upper right.
An upright barrel-shaped drum that tapers toward a flat base. An elliptical rim forms the open top, with a second parallel band just below it marking the drumhead collar.
A cylindrical drum with rounded top and bottom hoops and a single vertical seam down its middle. Two long drumsticks cross in an X just above the top hoop.
An upright guitar with a figure-eight body. A round sound hole sits in the upper bout above a short horizontal bridge, and a narrow neck rises to a head with one small side peg.
An upright harp with a tall straight pillar at the left and a curving neck arching across the top to the right. Several vertical strings fill the triangular frame above a flat horizontal base.
An upright rounded player with a small square screen above a round click wheel. An earphone cable loops up from its top edge, arcs over to the right, and ends in a small curled earbud.
A rounded pear-shaped lute body lies on a diagonal toward the lower left, with a round sound hole and a slanted bridge bar. A straight fretted neck marked by two frets rises to the upper right.
Two maracas cross at their handles to form a V. Each has a round head at the top and a long straight handle tapering to a rounded end at the bottom centre.

A flying-V electric guitar stands upright at the left, its pointed body and slotted headstock on a long neck. A boxy amplifier with a rounded top and a large round speaker sits overlapped behind it at the right.
A wide elliptical cymbal seen at a slight angle, with a small bell and a short post rising from its centre. A single vertical pole drops beneath it to a three-legged tripod foot.
A hand enters from the lower right with its fingers laid flat across a round record, as if scratching. The record shows a centre hole and a short curved sheen arc at its upper left.
A hand rises from the lower right with its index finger pressing a grid of square pads open on its right side. A pair of beamed eighth notes floats above the fingertip at the upper right.
An open book with two splayed pages sits on a single pole with a tripod foot. A single eighth note and a pair of beamed notes float to the right of the stand.
A tall treble clef with a looped top, a curled centre spiral and a hooked tail stands at the centre. Four horizontal staff lines run out to each side, broken where the clef crosses them.
A landscape ticket with semicircular notches cut into both short sides. A pair of beamed eighth notes sits at its centre.
A column of numerals 1, 2 and 3 runs down the left side. At the right, an upward triangle and a downward triangle sit above and below a short horizontal bar.

A trapezoidal metronome body with a flat top and a wide base. A pendulum rod with a round weight near its lower pivot swings to the right, extending past the body edge, beside a short vertical centre mark.
A single eighth note with an oval head at the lower left and a tall stem rising from its right side. A flag descends from the stem top in an S-shaped wave.
Two oval note heads at the bottom, each with a tall stem rising from its right side. A single slanted beam joins the stem tops, rising from left to right.
Two oval note heads at the bottom with tall stems rising from their right sides. Two parallel slanted beams join the stems, the lower one short of the stem tops.
A single eighth note with a round head at the lower left and a tall stem rising from its right side. A long smooth flag sweeps from the stem top down to the right.
An upright rounded-rectangle player. A pair of beamed eighth notes fills the upper half, above a large round control wheel in the lower half.
Two round note heads sit level at the bottom, each with a tall stem rising from its right side. One gently slanted beam joins the stem tops, rising slightly to the right.

A row of seven vertical pipes of stepped length, longest at the left and shortest at the right, forming a sloped lower edge. A horizontal binding band crosses near the top, below a row of open pipe ends.
A landscape rounded rectangle of white keys divided by two vertical lines. Two tall rounded black keys rise from the top edge, each overlapping a divider.
A grand piano in side view with a flat, rounded case on two straight legs. The lid is propped open on a long diagonal, rising to a notched peak at the right above a raised music desk.
Three horizontal list lines: a long one across the top and two shorter ones below it at the left. A right-pointing rounded play triangle sits beside the two short lines.
Two short horizontal list lines at the upper left. A single eighth note with a round head and a curled flag stands at the right, its stem rising past the lines.
A symmetrical headband arches over two tall rounded earcups. The band meets each earcup at its upper inner edge, leaving the space between them open.
A round tambourine frame seen face-on, with four small jingle discs spaced around its rim at the top, left, right and lower left.
A horizontal trumpet with a mouthpiece at the left and a flared triangular bell at the right. Three upright valves sit over an oval loop of tubing beneath the straight lead pipe.
A curved animal-style horn with a wide oval opening at the upper left. The body sweeps down in a deep U and narrows to a short angled mouthpiece at the right.
A large flared horn rises diagonally to a point at the top, curving back into a narrow neck above a flat rectangular base. A turntable platter and a short tonearm sit on the base below the horn.
A landscape rounded-rectangle cassette. A capsule-shaped window with an oval reel at each end sits in the upper middle, above a trapezoidal tape guide on the bottom edge.
A landscape rounded-rectangle cassette. Two round reels joined by a narrow tape bar sit in the upper middle, above a trapezoidal tape guide on the bottom edge.
An upright portable player with a round speaker between top and bottom bands stands at the centre. A headband arches over it, with a small earcup at each side.
A tall rectangular cassette player with a small tab on top and a short clip line down its right side stands at the centre. A headband arches over it, with a small earcup at each side.

A landscape portable player body with a cassette peeking out of a slot along its top. A slanted tape window with a small reel mark sits at the lower right, beside a short horizontal line at the upper left.
Four vertical bars of decreasing length stand side by side, tallest at the left. A mallet with a round head crosses the lower right bars on a diagonal.
